instructions.title: Your response: before you file (do not file this page)
lines: This file has the Response to Petition of Employer (WV-0104) and the Proof of Service of Completed Response (WV-0105).
File the Response with the clerk. Then someone else, not you, gives or mails a copy to the employer or its lawyer, and fills in the Proof of Service. Bring it to the hearing or give it to the clerk.
Go to the hearing, and bring any witnesses. If you do not go, the court may grant the orders without you.
A lawyer can help. If you do not have one, the lawyer referral service of your local bar association may be able to help.
Sign and date the Response by hand. You sign under penalty of perjury.
Print 3 copies, unless the clerk tells you otherwise.
This page is not part of your filing. Remove it before you file.
